verdict.rationale: The SDK is itself a documented programmatic API. The docs cover the Runner entry points (run, run_sync, run_streamed), streaming results, sessions, tools, handoffs, and resumable RunState for human-in-the-loop flows. Community users report building and running agents with it hands-on, and a probe shows docs are published as markdown with an llms.txt index for AI consumption. Missing for 10: no machine-readable API spec (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404), and the evidence cites guide pages rather than a formal API reference.
